name: Best Bid Next Generation
summary: Electrical estimating sold as a one-time purchase, from a company whose page says electrical estimating is its sole focus.
differentiator: States a one-time price and says plainly there are no per-seat, support or yearly update fees. It takes the opposite design approach to the big libraries: one master assembly you edit, plus unlimited custom assemblies.
pricing: $2,500 one-time for Best Bid Next Generation. A server addition is $3,500. Interest-free financing is offered. The vendor says there are no per-seat, support or yearly update fees.

scope.takeoff: Built-in on-screen takeoff with Auto Count.
scope.library: One master assembly you change, plus unlimited custom assemblies. No library count stated.
scope.laborUnits: Labor summarized by item, phase or assembly. The source of the units is not stated.

materialPrices.note: Material pricing via NetPricer or Real-Time Pricing. What either costs is not stated.

bestFor: Owner-estimators who want to pay once and build their own assemblies.
skipIf: You want a large prebuilt assembly library to start from.
watchOut: "Half the cost of other software" is Best Bid's own claim.
A price-feed service may still cost extra. The page does not say.
Best Bid Hybrid Pro is still supported for existing owners but is no longer the lead product.
